import os
import pandas as pd

print("CWD:", os.getcwd())
print("Files:", os.listdir("."))

path = "budget.xlsx"
if not os.path.exists(path):
    raise SystemExit("budget.xlsx not found")

sheets = pd.read_excel(path, sheet_name=None, header=None)
for name, df in sheets.items():
    print(f"\n=== Sheet: {name} ({df.shape[0]} rows x {df.shape[1]} cols) ===")
    print(df.to_string())

import zipfile

z = zipfile.ZipFile("budget.xlsx")
xml = z.read("xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml").decode("utf-8")
print(xml)

import zipfile
import re
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

M = "{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}"
z = zipfile.ZipFile("budget.xlsx")
root = ET.fromstring(z.read("xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml"))

vals = {}
for c in root.iter(M + "c"):
    ref = c.get("r")
    v = c.find(M + "v")
    if v is not None and v.text not in (None, ""):
        vals[ref] = float(v.text)

def col_idx(ref):
    letters = re.match(r"[A-Z]+", ref).group()
    return sum((ord(ch) - 64) * 26 ** i for i, ch in enumerate(reversed(letters)))

expense_refs = [f"C{r}" for r in range(11, 23)]
expenses = [(r, vals[r]) for r in expense_refs if r in vals]
total_expenses = sum(v for _, v in expenses)

income_refs = [f"B{r}" for r in range(4, 8)]
total_income = sum(vals[r] for r in income_refs if r in vals)

print("Income items:", [(r, vals[r]) for r in income_refs])
print("Total Income (matches B8 =SUM(B4:B7)):", total_income)
print()
for cat, r in [(vals["B11"], 11), (vals["B14"], 14), (vals["B17"], 17), (vals["B19"], 19), (vals["B21"], 21)]:
    pass
print("Expense rows (C11:C22):")
for r, v in expenses:
    print(f"  {r}: {v:g}")
print("Total Expenses (matches C23 =SUM(C11:C22)):", total_expenses)
print("Balance per existing formula B25 =B8-C22:", total_income - vals["C22"])
